---
title: "Reproduce and check results"
---

## Set up the downloaded companion

Download and extract the [complete ZIP](https://zenodo.org/records/24382209/files/Statistical_Programming_Stage8_Reader_Companion.zip?download=1), or extract both site volumes into the same directory. Open the resulting
`Statistical_Programming_Reader_Companion` folder. Check the manifest with
the supplied SHA-256 command and restore the documented Python and R
environments in `environments/README.md`.

```sh
sha256sum -c --quiet MANIFEST.sha256
python projects/build.py --output build/project-reports
```

On macOS, `shasum -a 256 -c MANIFEST.sha256` checks the same manifest.
The project generator checks 63 baseline report metrics against the frozen
outputs and performs 90 fresh Python–DuckDB sensitivity comparisons.
For a complete model refit, use the chapter route in the project specification.

## Select an analytical route

Run Python, R and supported SQL examples with the matching source files and
the documented environment. Run Stata locally using an installed licensed
copy and the supplied do-file. The archived licensed Stata results provide
a reference when a new native Stata process is unavailable.

The full book runner also checks provider files whose originals are not
redistributed in the public ZIP. Follow `data/reader_access.md` before
attempting that author-review audit. The released teaching projects and
their checked outputs remain available in the reader package.

## Read the verification evidence

The Stage 8 run executed all ten parts in Python, R and DuckDB with matched
licensed Stata evidence replay. Parts I–IX passed 81,910 primary comparisons.
Part X records the pilot, reporting, disclosure and tagged capstone checks
separately. The optional causal forest retains its earlier archived run.

- [Stage 8 run summary](run_summary.json)
- [Review and editing scope](review_scope.md)
- [Chapter review matrix](chapter_review.csv)
- [Solution calculation checks](solution_verification.json)

Detailed logs, output files and comparison ledgers are in
`verification/stage8/` inside the downloads. The review record documents
AI-assisted assessment and the separate external human sign-off still required.
